purpose.description: Your code fulfills the task of building a table-based schedule for the Wine Festival and renders a complete HTML document with a styled table.
The table includes a header with the title spanning two columns and a second header row for Time and Event, matching the described tasks.

readability.description: Good use of semantic table elements (thead, tbody, th, td) and descriptive class names like left.
Code is fairly readable with indentation and consistent structure. Consider ensuring consistent heading tag usage inside table cells.

performance.description: The page should render quickly; CSS selectors are straightforward and not overly heavy.
If you want to further optimize, ensure the font-face usage is fallBacks and consider smallerPayload by removing unused CSS rules in style.css for production.
